attribution: GeoSpec W5b pierced-bore and exterior-cone fixtures: replicad tubes, shafts and blocks cut with makeCylinder, makeBox or a revolved tool, written by replicad's blobSTEP (OCCT STEPControl_Writer).
runtimeDependency: All runtime inputs are files in this directory. The generator locator is attribution only and is never read by the test.
bytePolicy: Byte-locked assets: do not reformat, regenerate, or alter expectations. The STEP headers carry the generation timestamp, so regeneration is not byte-identical.

files.description: Tube r = 15 with a through bore r = 6, height 20 (makeCylinder cut); a radial set-screw hole r = 2 along +x at z = 10 pierces the bore wall across its seam.
As p0 with the set-screw hole along +y, so the opening is its own wire beside the seam.
As p0 with two cross holes r = 2 along x and y through both walls: four openings in the bore wall.
As p1 with both outer rims chamfered 0.5 mm: two cones with material on their axis side.
Pipe tee r = 10 with bores r = 6 on z and x: the branch bore meets the main bore tangentially where the equal radii cross.
As p0 without the screw, with a box window through one wall between z = 7 and z = 13: its planes cut the bore wall in coaxial arcs inside the band.
Shaft r = 5, length 30, its top rim chamfered 1 mm: an exterior cone.
Block 30 x 30 x 20 with a blind bore r = 4 ending in a revolved drill-point cone.
